name: habridge
summary: [Habridge](https://github.com/bwssytems/ha-bridge/) emulates Philips Hue API to other home automation gateways such as an Amazon Echo/Dot Gen 1 (gen 2 has issues discovering ha-bridge) or other systems that support Philips Hue. The Bridge handles basic commands such as On, Off and brightness commands of the hue protocol. This bridge can control most devices that have a distinct API.

volumes.description: Where HABridge stores config files and data.

docs.setup:
To set up the ha-bridge simply go to http://localhost:8080. Once you are in the webui you can add devices and configure ha-bridge to your liking.

For information on how to configure ha-bridge, go to their wiki at [https://github.com/bwssytems/ha-bridge/wiki](https://github.com/bwssytems/ha-bridge/wiki)
